41900.synonym: anukūla, anucchavi, anucchavika, anurūpa, anuloma, upiya, kappa, tajja, tathārūpa, tadanurūpa, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpaka, patirūpī, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāmaggiya, sāruppa

examples.text: yattakā bhikkhū tassa uposathakammassa pattayuttā anurūpā, sabb'antimena paricchedena cattāro bhikkhū pakatattā, saṅghena anukkhittā, te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmayaṃ ṭhitā.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

41901.meaning1: reached sanctuary; attained awakening; accomplished spiritual success; epithet of an arahant
41901.commentary: (DNa) pattayogakkhemā'ti catūhi yogehi khemattā arahattaṃ idha yogakkhemaṃ nāma, taṃ pattā'ti attho.

examples.text: etehi ce'pi, cunda, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ hoti, satthā ca hoti thero rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo-anuppatto, no ca khv'assa therā bhikkhū sāvakā honti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā.

41902.commentary: (VINa) pattaleso nāma sumbhakapattadharo diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto. aññaṃ sumbhakapattadharaṃ passitvā codeti, sumbhakapattadharo mayā diṭṭho.

examples.text: kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāyā'ti leso nāma dasa lesā, jātileso, nāmaleso, gottaleso, liṅgaleso, āpattileso, pattaleso, cīvaraleso, upajjhāyaleso, ācariyaleso, sen'āsanaleso.

41903.meaning1: attentive to the bowl; aware of the bowl

examples.text: pattasaññī piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pattasaññinā piṇḍapāto paṭiggahetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca tahaṃ tahaṃ olokento piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

41904.meaning1: perceiving as attained; thinking one has accomplished (something)
41904.commentary: (VINa) adiṭṭhe diṭṭhasaññino'ti arahatte ñāṇacakkhunā adiṭṭhey'eva, diṭṭhaṃ amhehi arahattan'ti diṭṭhasaññino hutvā. esa nayo appatt'ādīsu.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū adiṭṭhe diṭṭhasaññino apatte pattasaññino anadhigate adhigatasaññino asacchikate sacchikatasaññino adhimānena aññaṃ byākariṃsu. tesaṃ aparena samayena rāgāya'pi cittaṃ namati dosāya'pi cittaṃ namati mohāya'pi cittaṃ namati.

41905.meaningLit: rule about receiving attentive to the bowl

41906.meaningLit: rule about (eating) attentive to the bowl

41907.meaning1: stash of bowls; collection of alms bowls
41907.commentary: (VINa) pattasannicayaṃ kareyyā'ti pattasannidhiṃ kareyya, ek'āhaṃ anadhiṭṭhahitvā vā avikappetvā vā pattaṃ ṭhapeyyā'ti attho.

41908.meaning1: rule about a store of bowls

examples.text: tam'enaṃ mūle chindeyya, mūle chetvā agge chindeyya, agge chetvā pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujeyya.

41916.commentary: (VINa) patt'ādhārake'pī'ti ettha rukkh'ādhārako vā hotu valay'ādhārako vā daṇḍ'ādhārako vā yaṃkiñci pattaṭṭhapanakaṃ pacchikā'pi hotu patt'ādhārako tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

examples.text: vehāsaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ vehāsagataṃ hoti. mañce vā pīṭhe vā cīvaravaṃse vā cīvararajjuyā vā bhittikhile vā nāgadante vā rukkhe vā laggitaṃ hoti, antamaso patt'ādhārake'pi.

anīkaṃ nāma hatth'ānīkaṃ, ass'ānīkaṃ, rath'ānīkaṃ, patt'ānīkaṃ. tayo hatthī pacchimaṃ hatth'ānīkaṃ, tayo assā pacchimaṃ ass'ānīkaṃ, tayo rathā pacchimaṃ rath'ānīkaṃ, cattāro purisā sarahatthā pattī pacchimaṃ patt'ānīkaṃ.

41919.commentary: (MNa) patt'āḷhakaṃ vuccati paṇṇanāḷikā, tāya vālik'ādīni minantā kīḷanti.

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, kumāro vuddhim'anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam'anvāya yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni tehi kīḷati, seyyath'idaṃ, vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ patt'āḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ.
yoniso manasikāro, dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno, n'atth'añño evaṃ bahukāro, uttam'atthassa pattiyā, yoniso padahaṃ bhikkhu, khayaṃ dukkhassa pāpuṇe'ti.
evaṃ vihārī ātāpī, ahorattam'atandito, bhāvayaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, yogakkhemassa pattiyā.
sace pattiṃ āharāpessati pattiṃ dassāmī'ti cintetvā
senā nāma hatthī assā rathā pattī. dvādasapuriso hatthī, tipuriso asso, catupuriso ratho, cattāro purisā sarahatthā patti. dassanāya gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
senābyūhaṃ nāma ito hatthī hontu, ito assā hontu, ito rathā hontu, ito pattikā hontu.
asi ca cammañ'ca asicammaṃ, dhanu ca kalāpo ca dhanukalāpaṃ, hatthī ca asso ca hatthi-assaṃ, ratho ca pattiko ca rathapattikaṃ. evaṃ sen'aṅg'atthe.

yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko'va yena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
kiñ'c'āpi te hatthikāyo vā rakkheyya, assakāyo vā rakkheyya, rathakāyo vā rakkheyya, pattikāyo vā rakkheyya, atha kho tesaṃ arakkhito attā.

41929.meaning1: sharing of merit; giving of profit
41929.meaning2: sharing of merit; giving of profit
41929.commentary: (ADht) attano santāne nibbattā patti dīyati etenā'ti pattidānaṃ.

examples.text: imaṃ evarūpaṃ pāsādaṃ kārentiyā yaṃ mayā puññaṃ pasutaṃ, taṃ anumodatha, pattidānaṃ vo dammī'ti.

41930.commentary: (MNa) pattipattassā'ti ye pattabbā guṇā, te pattassa. (SNPa) pattipattā'ti ettha pattabbā'ti patti, pattabbā nāma pattuṃ arahā, yaṃ patvā accantayogakkhemino honti, arahattaphalassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ, taṃ pattiṃ pattā'ti pattipattā.

examples.text: yaṃ me kaṅkhitam'aññāsi, vicikicchā maṃ tārayi namo te, muni monapathesu pattipatta, akhila ādiccabandhu sorato'si.
ye suppayuttā manasā daḷhena, nikkāmino gotamasāsanamhi, te pattipattā amataṃ vigayha, laddhā mudhā nibbutiṃ bhuñjamānā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

41931.commentary: (JAa) te honti parapattiyā'ti te paraghos'ānusārino tam'eva paraghosasaṅkhātaṃ panādaṃ paraman'ti maññamānā bālā andhaputhujjanā viññāṇapadassa appattatāya parapattiyāva honti, paresaṃ vacanaṃ saddahitvā yaṃ vā taṃ vā karonti.

examples.text: paṇḍitā nāma tādisena parapattiyena apaccakkhakārinā saddhiṃ na vasantī'ti

yāni'pi tāni, bhante, raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddh'āvasittānaṃ… ajjhāvasantānaṃ assayuddhāni bhavanti… rathayuddhāni bhavanti… pattiyuddhāni bhavanti, tesam'pi, bhante, pattiyuddhānaṃ n'atthi gati n'atthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.

41935.meaning1: sound of foot soldiers; noise of infantrymen

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthisaddaṃ vā sutvā assasaddaṃ vā sutvā rathasaddaṃ vā sutvā pattisaddaṃ vā sutvā bheri-paṇava-saṅkha-tiṇava-ninnāda-saddaṃ vā sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati, na santhambhati na sakkoti saṅgāmaṃ otarituṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ.
kiṃ pattinam'āhu bhikkhunaṃ, sorataṃ kena kathañ'ca dantam'āhu. buddho'ti kathaṃ pavuccati, puṭṭho me bhagavā byākarohi.

41937.meaning1: infantry; one of the four military divisions

examples.text: senā nāma hatthī assā rathā pattī. dvādasapuriso hatthī, tipuriso asso, catupuriso ratho, cattāro purisā sarahatthā patti. dassanāya gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
bal'aggaṃ nāma ettakā hatthī, ettakā assā, ettakā rathā, ettakā pattī.

41938.commentary: (VINa) pattuṇṇan'ti pattuṇṇadese pāṇakehi sañjātavatthaṃ. dve paṭā desanāmen'eva vuttā. tāni tīṇi koseyyass'ānulomāni. dukūlaṃ sāṇassa, itarāni dve kappāsikassa vā sabbesaṃ vā.

examples.text: bhagavatā cha cīvarāni anuññātāni. dhammasaṅgāhakattherehi tesaṃ anulomāni dukūlaṃ, pattuṇṇaṃ, cīnapaṭṭaṃ, somārapaṭṭaṃ, iddhimayikaṃ, devadattiyan'ti aparāni cha anuññātāni.

41939.meaning1: to reach; to attain; to arrive (at)
41939.meaning2: to reach, to attain, to arrive at, to obtain

examples.text: attano sāmike kāsāvadhare muṇḍakasīse disvā cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ na bhaveyya, tena maggaphalāni pattuṃ na sakkuṇeyyuṃ. tasmā acalasaddhāya patiṭṭhitakāle tāsaṃ te bhikkhū arahattappatte'y'eva dassesi
yattha kho, āvuso, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, n'āhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyan'ti vadāmī'ti.
so patt'odakaṃ paṭiggaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti, na pattaṃ onāmeti, na pattaṃ sannāmeti, na pattaṃ vināmeti. so patt'odakaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti n'ātithokaṃ n'ātibahuṃ.
araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ

41943.meaning2: measure of grain or liquid, four of which make a seer. See pasata
41943.notes:
1 pattha = 1/2 magadhanāḷi
4 kuṭuva = 1 pattha
4 pattha = 1 āḷhaka

examples.text: vanacārī pure āsiṃ, satataṃ vanakammiko, pattha-odanaṃ gahetvāna, kamm'antaṃ agamās'ahaṃ.
omako nāma patto patth'odanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadupiyaṃ byañjanaṃ. tato ukkaṭṭho apatto, omako apatto.
atha kho, assalāyana, asito devalo isi kesamassuṃ kappetvā mañjiṭṭhavaṇṇāni dussāni nivāsetvā paṭaliyo upāhanā āruhitvā jātarūpamayaṃ daṇḍaṃ gahetvā sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ patthaṇḍile pāturahosi.
oṭṭhappahatamattena, attānam'pi na passati, patthaddhagīvo carati, ahaṃ seyyo'ti maññati.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vāseṭṭha, api nu tassa purisassa avhāyanahetu vā āyācanahetu vā patthanahetu vā abhinandanahetu vā aciravatiyā nadiyā pārimaṃ tīraṃ orimaṃ tīraṃ āgaccheyyā'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.

41951.meaning1: due to the wish; because of the aspiration
41951.meaning2: due to the wish; because of the aspiration

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vāseṭṭha, api nu tassa purisassa avhāyanahetu vā āyācanahetu vā patthanahetu vā abhinandanahetu vā aciravatiyā nadiyā pārimaṃ tīraṃ orimaṃ tīraṃ āgaccheyyā'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.

41952.meaning1: made an aspiration; set the intention; prayed

examples.text: so satthārā dinnanaye ṭhatvā satthāraṃ vanditvā, ajja ādiṃ katvā mama santakaṃ dasikasuttamattam'pi maṃ abhibhavitvā anekasatā'pi rājāno vā corā vā gaṇhituṃ samatthā nāma mā hontu, agginā'pi mama santakaṃ mā ḍayhatu, udakenapi mā vuyhatū'ti patthanaṃ akāsi.
hīnaṃ kaccāna dhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati hīnā saññā hīnā diṭṭhi hīno vitakko hīnā cetanā hīnā patthanā
ayaṃ buddhattāya abhinīhāraṃ katvā nipanno, samijjhissati imassa patthanā, ito kappasatasahass'ādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake gotamo nāma buddho bhavissati.

41954.meaning1: due to forming an intention; due to making an aspiration

41955.meaning1: due to wishing; because of praying; by making an aspiration

examples.text: imesaṃ kho, gahapati, pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ na āyācanahetu vā patthanāhetu vā paṭilābhaṃ vadāmi

41956.meaning2: famousness, state of being sought after

41957.commentary: (VINa) patthapatthapulakan'ti ekam'ekassa bhikkhuno patthapatthapamāṇaṃ pulakaṃ. pattho nāma nāḷimattaṃ hoti, ekassa purisassa alaṃ yāpanāya. vuttam'pi h'etaṃ, patth'odano nālamayaṃ duvinnan'ti (jā 2.21.192)

examples.text: pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
sace cuto sīlavatato hoti, pavedhatī kamma virādhayitvā, pajappatī patthayatī ca suddhiṃ, satthā'va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā.
jaheyya sabbasaṃyogaṃ, kareyya saraṇ'attano, careyy'ādittasīso'va, patthayaṃ accutaṃ padan'ti.

41961.commentary: (ITIa) patthayamānassā'ti dve patthanā taṇhāpatthanā, kusalacchandapatthanā ca… chinnaṃ pāpimato sotaṃ, viddhastaṃ vinaḷīkataṃ, pāmojjabahulā hotha, khemaṃ patthetha bhikkhavo'ti, ettha kattu'kamyatā-kusalacchanda-patthanā, ayam'eva idh'ādhippetā. tena patthayamānassā'ti taṃ yogakkhemaṃ gantu'kāmassa tan'ninnassa tap'poṇassa tap'pabbhārassā'ti attho.

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, sukhāni patthayamāno sīlaṃ rakkheyya paṇḍito. katamāni tīṇi?
patthayamānassa hi jappitāni, pavedhitaṃ vā'pi pakappitesu, cut'ūpapāto idha yassa n'atthi, sa kena vedheyya kuhiṃ'va jappe.

41962.commentary: (ITIa) patthayamānassā'ti dve patthanā taṇhāpatthanā, kusalacchandapatthanā ca. patthayamānassa hi jappitāni, pavedhitaṃ vā'pi pakappitesū'ti, ettha taṇhāpatthanā.

examples.text: bhoge patthayamānena, uḷāre apar'āpare, appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā.
sīlaṃ rakkheyya medhāvī, patthayāno tayo sukhe, pasaṃsaṃ vittalābhañ'ca, pecca sagge pamodanaṃ.
tasmā hi te sukhino vītasokā, yesaṃ piyaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, tasmā asokaṃ virajaṃ patthayāno, piyaṃ na kayirātha kuhiñci loke'ti.
nānācittehi pupphehi, pūjayitvā sasāvakaṃ, nipacca pādamūlamhi, taṃ ṭhānaṃ patthayiṃ ahaṃ.

41965.meaning1: having wished; having made an aspiration (for)
41965.meaning2: having wished for, having desired, having aspired

41966.commentary: (SNa) pañca pana kāmaguṇā assā pattharaṇaṭṭhānā, tesu sā pattharatī'ti pañcapattharā.

examples.text: ekamūlaṃ dvi'r'āvaṭṭaṃ, timalaṃ pañcapattharaṃ, samuddaṃ dvādas'āvaṭṭaṃ, pātālaṃ atarī isī'ti.

41972.meaning1: having spread out; having stretched out

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggaṇhitvā dakkhiṇena pādena pattharitvā, yo tattha sāro taṃ paripātetvā ādāya pakkameyya.
muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.
etādisaṃ ce ratanaṃ na icchasi, nāriṃ nar'indehi bahūhi patthitaṃ, diṭṭhigataṃ sīlavataṃ nu jīvitaṃ, bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisaṃ.
icchitaṃ patthitaṃ tumhaṃ khippam'eva samijjhatu, sabbe pūrentu saṅkappā, cando paṇṇaraso yathā, maṇi jotiraso yathā
duggatā devakaññāyo, sakkāyasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā, te c'āpi duggatā sattā, devakaññāhi patthitā'ti.
yadā so jīvati, tadā lahutaro ca hoti mudutaro ca kammaññataro ca. yadā pana so kālaṅ'kato hoti tadā garutaro ca hoti patthinnataro ca akammaññataro ca.
sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sa pannabhāro muni vippamutto, na kappiyo n'ūparato na patthiyo'ti.

41979.meaning1: wishes; aspire; craves (for); sets one's heart (on)
41979.commentary: (CPa) ko kiṃ icchatī'ti brāhmaṇādīsu yo koci satto annādīsu deyyadhammesu yaṃ kiñci icchati. patthetī'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: t'eva, mahārāja, rūpā ekaccassa manāpā honti, t'eva rūpā ekaccassa amanāpā honti. yehi ca yo rūpehi attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo, so tehi rūpehi aññaṃ rūpaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na pattheti. te tassa rūpā paramā honti. te tassa rūpā anuttarā honti.
tatth'āhaṃ divase tikkhattuṃ, ghosāpemi tahiṃ tahiṃ, ko kiṃ icchati pattheti, kassa kiṃ dīyatū dhanaṃ.
pāpamitte vivajjetvā, bhajeyy'uttamapuggalaṃ, ovāde c'assa tiṭṭheyya, patthento acalaṃ sukhaṃ.

41991.synonym: upāya, ñāya, niyāma, bhāva, saṅkhāra, samaya
41991.notes: (PED) very frequent as in comp, where it is sometimes pleonastic, and acts in the function of an abstract formation in -tā or -ttaṃ

examples.text: yo ca papañcaṃ hitvāna, nippapañcapathe rato, ārādhayī so nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.
kodho mosavajjañ'ca kathaṃkathā ca, ete'pi dhammā dvayam'eva sante, kathaṃkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe, ñatvā pavuttā samaṇena dhammā.

41994.meaning1: staying on track; remaining on course

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… candaggāho bhavissati, sūriyaggāho bhavissati, nakkhattaggāho bhavissati, candimasūriyānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati, candimasūriyānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati

41995.meaning2: keeps on the track, carries on

examples.text: buddhā saṅgāhakā loke, tehi etaṃ sudesitaṃ, eso hetu mahantassa, pathabyo me na vipajjati.

41997.grammar: fem, gen sg of pathavī, irreg form of pathaviyā
41997.meaning1: of the earth; of the whole wide world
41997.commentary: (VINa) pathabyā rājā'ti sakalapathaviyā rājā dīpacakkavattī asokasadiso, yo vā pan'añño'pi ekadīpe rājā, sīhaḷarājasadiso. (APAa) pathabyā pathaviyā

examples.text: pathabyā ekarajjena, saggassa gamanena vā, sabbalok'ādhipaccena, sot'āpattiphalaṃ varaṃ.
rājāno nāma pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mah'āmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ karontā anusāsanti. ete rājāno nāma.

41998.meaning1: ruler of the earth; king of the whole wide world
41998.commentary: (VINa) pathabyā rājā'ti sakalapathaviyā rājā dīpacakkavattī asokasadiso, yo vā pan'añño'pi ekadīpe rājā, sīhaḷarājasadiso.

examples.text: rājāno nāma pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mah'āmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ karontā anusāsanti. ete rājāno nāma.

pathaviṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, pathavito abhiññāya yāvatā pathaviyā pathavattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya pathaviṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviyā n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathavito n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.
